## Purpose

Send an SMS directly from MethodMesh and return the local send-request status.

## Capability IDs

- `sms.send`

## Requirements

- Android SEND_SMS permission.
- Device and subscription capable of sending SMS.

## Supported XLSForm calls


**From `example_odk_sms.send.xlsx`:**

```text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='sms.send',input_sms_phone=${phone_number},input_sms_message=${sms_message_calc},return_mode='flat')
```


## Inputs observed in supplied examples

| Field | Label | XLSForm type |
|---|---|---|
| start | Start time | start |
| phone_number | Phone number | text |
| field_value | Value to include in SMS | text |
